## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour. For documentation/build
work, explain what a reader or developer can now do more clearly or reliably.

## Evidence

- Local checks run and results:
- CI revision/result, or why not available:
- User/device observations if relevant; keep unperformed scenarios explicit:

## Boundaries

- Runtime, configuration or data compatibility impact:
- Deployment/rollback requirements, if any:
- Related decision, trial or companion PR:

Do not include private photos, options, credentials or signing material. Runtime
PRs remain open during an approved exact-revision trial. Local/CI success is not
device acceptance, and deployment approval is not merge approval.
